question: Takmer všetky slovenské rieky odnesú vodu cez Dunaj do Čierneho mora. Rieka Poprad je však výnimka, lebo tečie na sever. Do ktorého mora sa jej voda nakoniec dostane?
source_excerpt: The Poprad is a river in Slovakia and Poland, a left tributary of the Dunajec... part of the Baltic Sea drainage basin

extra.why_interesting: Slovaks assume all their rivers end up in the Danube and the Black Sea. The 'flows north' hint lets them work out that a Slovak river ends in the Baltic, so part of Slovakia drains toward the sea off Poland and Sweden.
extra.verification_notes: Poprad drains to Dunajec, then Vistula, then the Baltic Sea (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Poprad_(river)); I did not run a search, so this rests on well-established knowledge.

explanation: Poprad sa vlieva do Dunajca, ten do Visly a Visla cez celé Poľsko až do Baltu. Cez Slovensko totiž prechádza hlavné európske rozvodie, ktoré je napríklad pri Štrbe označené aj tabuľou.

question: Dunaj preteká viacerými hlavnými mestami než ktorákoľvek iná rieka na svete. Jedným z nich je Bratislava. Koľkými hlavnými mestami preteká spolu?
source_excerpt: It passes through four capital cities, more than any other river in the world.

extra.why_interesting: Players know the Danube passes Bratislava but rarely see it as a world record holder. They can count the capitals by mentally following the river downstream, which makes the question winnable.
extra.verification_notes: The Danube flows through four capitals (Vienna, Bratislava, Budapest, Belgrade), more than any other river, per https://worldatlas.com/articles/which-river-passes-through-most-national-capital-cities.html.

explanation: Sú to Viedeň, Bratislava, Budapešť a Belehrad, takže žiadna iná rieka na svete nespája toľko hlavných miest. Viedeň a Bratislava pritom ležia na Dunaji len asi 60 kilometrov od seba.
